The source concerns passive-component Extended fees and does not change the established interboard connector types, pinouts, or topology.
The source does not change panel input assignments or connector-based mounting.
The passive-component cost review does not alter battery connector placement, orientation, clearance, or spacing.
The source does not change the sensor-board connector inventory, pinouts, or connector count.
Component Extended-part fees do not affect the established ESP32-S3 GPIO assignments or compatibility constraints.
The source does not identify the LED supply or level-shifter part as changing and therefore leaves the electrical requirement unchanged.
The client explicitly treats an Extended fee for the AXP as expected and does not change the AXP2101 power-path design.
